description:
Your Resolution Campagnolo

THE LATEST EVOLUTION OF OUR UNIQUE MASON RESOLUTION, WITH CONFIGURABLE CAMPAGNOLO BUILD OPTIONS

The resolution is our steel road bicycle for multi-surface conditions. Crafted by highly experienced Italian makers, the Resolution uses modern design thinking and proven MASON geometry, combined with the latest, progressive features and custom Columbus steel tubing. The Resolution delivers a fast smooth ride, along with confidence-inspiring, dependable, all-season, long-distance performance, across a wide range of surfaces. "If you’re looking for a versatile steel road bike that’s a joy to spend long days on..the Mason Resolution will not leave you disappointed." | Bike Radar.

The Resolution taps into the many benefits of steel, with its legendary qualities for performance bike frames. Steel's elastic properties lend life and feel to the ride and its excellent fatigue properties mean that with proper corrosion protection, the frame will last a very long time.

After working with many frame-building materials over the years, we became really interested in developing a performance steel frame when Columbus introduced their beautiful ’Spirit’ and ‘Life’ tube sets. Combining these tubes with modern componentry and progressive geometry was the formula for something very special.

The Columbus ’Niobium Doped’ alloy that is used to produce the Spirit and Life tubing really makes this an exciting material to use for a lightweight, performance bike. Their fine-grained, micro-alloyed steel allows wall dimensions as low as 0.4mm, giving really low weights along with high fatigue resistance and excellent welding qualities.

Campagnolo's 12-speed Chorus Disc Brake groupset is the solution that combines racing performance with rider needs for endurance. The reliable and expertly crafted Chorus groupset partnered with our award-winning, hand crafted Resolution frameset ensures this highly capable bicycle effortlessly handles the all-road rider's needs.

T47 bottom bracket for added stability

Anti-corrosion coating applied inside and out by cataphoresis

100% Italian TIG-welded/silver-brazed frame manufacturing, wet-painting, and finishing.

Full set of high-grade, stainless steel accessory mounting screws and small parts, including cable routing parts and MASON Multiport inserts, supplied with frameset.

Available with a choice of the best 700C tyres from Rene Herse, Schwalbe, Continental & Vittoria.

Available with a choice of HUNT, DT Swiss and Campagnolo wheelsets. Other options available on request.

Available with 'MASON Luminance Upgrade'. The ultimate dynamo + lighting set-up for all-terrain and multi-surface adventures. Select through Configurator.

Carbon MASON Penta microadjust seatpost and MASON Macro seatclamp.

Available with Super Record 13, Record, EKAR or a choice of other Campagnolo groupsets

MASON Aperture2 full carbon fork. Thru-Axle/Flat-Mount, with replaceable F-Stop fork dropouts and MASON SwitchLever axles.

The fork can take a Ø140 or Ø160mm rotor [using adaptor], if you are using Shimano IceTech rotors then Ø140mm rotors either end are fine in normal use, although Shimano recommend Ø160 both ends for larger riders or extended long descents, especially when loaded. SRAM recommend Ø160mm front/rear. A Ø160mm up front is best if you are using cable braking. The Resolution2, with Thru-Axle front & rear will now accept a Ø160mm rotor on the rear. [140mm is the maximum recommended diameter for the V1 rear].
